invariants.text: No global landlord/tenant role on USER.
Each Organization has exactly one primary owner/operator in MVP.
Each Property belongs to exactly one Organization.
Room operational state and archive lifecycle remain separate.
Published Listing requires eligible VACANT active Room under active Property.
One Room has at most one current non-archived Listing.
One Room has at most one non-terminal Tenancy.
Active Tenancy has exactly one active PRIMARY participant.
Participant may exist without a linked User.
Terms are versioned and acknowledgement is version-specific.
Financial Terms change only at the next Billing Cycle boundary in MVP.
Every Billing Cycle stores its applied Terms version provenance.
Billing Cycle periods for one Tenancy do not overlap.
Charge types are exactly RENT/ELECTRICITY/WATER in current scope.
Payment belongs to exactly one Tenancy.
Payment Allocation may be partial/multi-charge/multi-cycle but never cross-Tenancy.
Deposit Payment Application never crosses Tenancy.
Sum of Payment Allocation + Deposit Payment Application amounts cannot exceed Payment amount.
Payment Claim is not Payment.
Confirmed Payment correction preserves history; replacement_payment_id, when present, links a voided/reversed Payment to its corrected Payment in the same Tenancy.
Receipt is derived from confirmed Payment and has max one current/non-voided record per Payment.
Deposit requirement truth belongs to Terms.
Deposit state is derived, not authoritative mutable input.
RECEIVED Deposit Event provenance is a Deposit Payment Application; DEPOSIT_EVENT.amount must equal the linked DEPOSIT_PAYMENT_APPLICATION.applied_amount.
REFUNDED/RETAINED Deposit Event provenance is a Deposit Settlement; REFUNDED.amount must equal DEPOSIT_SETTLEMENT.refunded_amount, and RETAINED.amount must equal DEPOSIT_SETTLEMENT.retained_amount.
Open Incident blocks Room/Property archive.
Trust Report targets exactly one Listing or Review.
Trust Report does not auto-remove content.
Review target is Property/Rental Experience, not a person.
Notification/History/Dashboard do not own business truth.
TENANCY_TERMS.version is unique within one Tenancy.
A Terms Acknowledgement participant belongs to the same Tenancy as the acknowledged Terms; its User is the linked account performing that action.

For an ELECTRICITY/WATER Charge, when utility provenance is recorded: the referenced Utility Connection belongs to the Room of the Charge's Billing Cycle Tenancy; its utility type matches the Charge type; and any start/end Meter Readings belong to that same Utility Connection. Meter readings cannot be referenced without their Utility Connection.
Review author Participant belongs to the Review Tenancy and is linked to the Review author User.
Payment Claim participant, when present, belongs to the same Tenancy as the claim.

REVIEW.property_id is captured at Review creation time and is not live-synced to the current Tenancy → Room → Property chain. Subsequent Room/Property reassignment does not retarget existing Reviews. Correction of an erroneous target is an explicit audited action, never a cascade.
PAYMENT_CLAIM.resulting_payment_id, when present, belongs to the same Tenancy as the Payment Claim.

openPolicies: Deposit requirement change after partially held
